passives.name: AizenEquipmentPassive1
passives.description:
When this unit is inflicted with a $StatusEffect or $Debuff:
- Reflect the attempt back to the source and follow-up with $Aizen_Skill1 for {1}% of this unit’s damage on the targeted enemy, inflicting $Hypnosis
- $Hypnosis: Stays active for {2} seconds. On expiry, teleport enemy back to the original spot where they received $Hypnosis
- Enemies inflicted with $Hypnosis will take {3}% more damage from $BleachCategory units.

Every {4}s:
- Inflict the {5} strongest enemies on the map with $Hypnosis
